data.narrative:
AIR is a Series A transportation company founded by Rani Plaut, Chen Rosen, and Netanel Goldberg, having raised $23M to date. The valuation universe consists of eight private frontier-transport peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero; no public comparables exist in the immediate sector.

The stage-progression method is applicable and forms the sole quantitative anchor for this analysis. Using total capital raised ($23M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $46M. The peer-median approach is not applicable here: while three same-sector transportation companies exist, none met minimum thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier clustering. A broad all-sector median would introduce unwarranted noise and was therefore excluded.

The triangulation yields a median valuation of $46M, with a range of $39M (low) to $53M (high) derived from stage-progression sensitivity analysis. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow peer comparables in transportation at comparable maturity and the reliance on a single method. Any refinement of this valuation would benefit from additional same-stage, same-sector datapoints and greater granularity on AIR's revenue or unit economics relative to the peer set.
